notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.4 is here!
notes.notes:
[b]Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.4:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Set the time limit before or during recording. [/b]
Press the timer button, set the time, and select the action after the recording ends. Simple and convenient!
[img]https://new-img.movavi.com/products/0013/41/4cb90fd428bb57185fa80b61dbb31b45f5e4ab28.png[/img]
[*] [b]The size of your recordings is now smaller, and the quality is better.
 [/b]
[*] [b]Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements. [/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.2 is here!
notes.notes:
[b]Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.2:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Noise reduction[/b]
No need to worry about loud neighbors or colleagues any longer! Our new noise reduction feature will help you get rid of extraneous sounds.

[*] [b]Audio control during capture[/b]
Forgot to turn the system sound on or disable the mic? Set your sound up during capture using the familiar buttons on the control panel.

[b][*] Minor improvements and bug fixes[/b][/list]
